criteria.requirement: Add EventProjector(fields,keep=(),missing="error"/"omit"/"default",default=None). Explicit output-alias to tuple/list path segments, str dict keys and nonnegative int list indexes, no implicit dotted-path interpretation or Python attribute access. Only retain requested top-level fields plus projections; reject alias/keep collision and invalid paths before processing. Actual None is present, missing paths follow explicit policy. Return new outer event preserving payload identity and source; do not infer entire schema or expand object tree.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
